name: AccesoPro · Motor de contenido en vídeo (Nivel 1)
description: Motor principal: un único disparador lee temario/podcast/PDF oficial, divide el tema en ideas, transcribe la clase y detecta clips, y lanza el sub-workflow de producción por pieza con tabla de control.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = new Date();
const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
const run_id = 'RUN_' + d.getUTCFullYear() + pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + pad(d.getUTCDate()) + 'T' + pad(d.getUTCHours()) + pad(d.getUTCMinutes()) + pad(d.getUTCSeconds()) + 'Z';
return {
  json: {
    run_id: run_id,
    topic_id: 'T1_S01',
    class_url: 'https://youtu.be/fQBP3hY39oU',
    class_video_path: '/data/in/clase.mp4',
    cfg: {
      writer_model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6',
      reviewer_model: 'gpt-5-mini',
      tts_model: 'eleven_multilingual_v2',
      voice_id: 'wAaI75MqrvvzQRMHEADR',
      publish_enabled: true,
      publish_format_script: '9x16',
      publish_format_clip: '16x9',
      clip_crop: '1440:1080:0:0',
      max_corrections: 1,
      n_scripts: 4,
      clips_min: 5,
      clips_max: 8,
      clip_min_seconds: 25,
      clip_max_seconds: 125,
      chunk_seconds: 600,
      max_pieces_per_run: 3,
      max_uploads_per_day: 8,
      daily_budget_usd: 8,
      force_ids: [],
      price_writer_in: 3,
      price_writer_out: 15,
      price_reviewer_in: 0.25,
      price_reviewer_out: 2,
      price_tts_per_1k_chars: 0.18,
      price_whisper_per_min: 0.006
    }
  }
};
